summary: The Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, dialogue, avatar presentation, and stealth sensing. Human avatars use a bare body with only worn outfit pieces attached as separate skinned models.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with shops, landmarks, simulated staff/shoppers, arcade games, and Glow Up Salon styling stations.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room systems, shifting walls, creature ecology, route guidance, Kade, and Zenith's sealed far-east breach.

places/level01 (3D) - Level 0.1, Zenith Station: versioned station/gallery, doors, breakables, bots/hazards, climate rooms, flight-recorder quest, and drones that refill destroyed posts after an hour.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 2 uses Tripo props over its collider shell and placed survivor head attachments; Level 2.1 has Base Alef and its authored route.

places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, Boiler Room rats, and climbable library ladders.

places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11, places/level12, places/level26 (3D) - Lights Out, Thalassophobia, Bumper Crop, Infinite City, Matrix, and SS Fun =) liner; Level 12 is a white room and furniture-strewn void with a ritual clock.
places/debug, places/spamton and other configured places (3D) - debug mannequin/body gallery and switch pad, Spamton's fight space, and auxiliary routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; climb.js runs after swim.js and quest-marker.js is the final player behavior.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; main sim owns Level 0 generation and place sims own local layouts/rebuilds/ticks.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival cutscene driver, BODIES toggle, and solo-place pause time-scale.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 scripts own its route and beats.
scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD and panels, including objective compass pip and crouch awareness readout.
places/level12/sim.js + places/level12/cells/*.scene - versioned Matrix room/void construction and shared ticking ritual clock; scripts/level12-use.js handles door and copydoor interactions.
places/level11/sim.js - versioned Infinite City construction and local city systems; also places Harris's expedition log and the lit window entity whose trigger leads to Level 12.

art/human-base/build.py + art/human-head/* + art/human-face/* + art/human-cloth/* + art/human-hair/build.py + art/tripo-hair/refit.py - offline human rig, heads/expressions, fitted wardrobe meshes and validation.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings, and last-level names including level01 and level12; routing and hub handlers use it.

scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat; cells feed Zenith laser weapons.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.
scripts/lib/screen.js + scripts/lib/footsteps.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player/stats/craft/rest/menu/vmpose; footsteps maps player stride sounds to surfaces.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/maze0path.js - seeded Level 0 cell/zone/wall/pit/pillar layout and open-point/BFS doorway steering shared by place simulation and smiler/lurker navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + wardrobe.yml + wardrobe-split.yml + critter.yml/faces.yml/hair.yml/critter-models.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - clothing loot/armor, deterministic looks, species/head/hair presentation; wardrobe-split maps sex-specific standalone garment GLBs attached to bare human bodies.

scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/knock.js - shared combat animation channels for player and M.E.G. agents; knock handling serves player heavy melee and enemy kick knockdowns.
scripts/lib/sneak.js + scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml - crouch visibility multiplier shared by smilers.js and lurkers.js hunter sight; player.js uses sneak tuning for gradual awareness/HUD detection.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickSnap, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/sneak.js - SNEAK, crouchMul.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
scripts/critter.js - update, onInput and face/blink handlers; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - body/face/head/spec and wardrobe fitting/restyling helpers, plus wardChildren and seatWardrobe.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.

scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js - KADE, ZEN_ENTRY, setZen, migrateZen, handleDialogueQuestZ, zenithChoice, layZenithEntry; scripts/zenith-use.js - ears, onSpawn, slide, grab, gone; scripts/zenith-scout.js - onTriggerEnter.

scripts/level12-use.js - ears, shut; scripts/level12-window.js - onTriggerEnter; scripts/lib/quest-mark.js - questMark, yawTo; scripts/quest-marker.js - updateSchedule, update; scripts/lib/knock.js - knocked, foeStats, RAG, powerKnock, death.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo (including cells), needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, level access, saved place/position, wakeAtSave restoration, and heat/cold meters.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold/release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.

scripts/lib/knock.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - foe attributes/weight and shared down/stagger knock outcomes; enemy managers retain AI state, while lurkers own caught-player lurkHold/lurkFree, stare/frenzy timing, and entity grab/frenzy/presence fields.

scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim. scripts/hub.js owns mall offers/shop/food, room-hop flags, trainHid/stungUntil, and transient crossing state.

scripts/climb.js owns local climb session/player.state.climbing and first-person arm viewmodel; scripts/lib/vmpose.js records session.vmHidKey and controls viewmodel visibility from scene/camera/screen context.

scripts/lib/zenith-quest.js + places/main/sim.js + places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - player zenQ/zenV/zenKey/zenDrive progression, versioned breach and station layout/drive bay, recorder animation state, local drone/climate state.

places/level12/sim.js owns place.state.v and session.clock12 construction/clock animation; player.state.r12 tracks seat seconds and tried/back timestamps, know12 records hearing Harris's log, and l12out counts successful exits.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim/climb, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/fights/horde/critter/menu/hub/view3/quest-marker.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects the player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done; menu UI renders on menuOpen and solo pause sets place.timeScale.
scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js select avatar and restyle occupants via critter-model.js.

Human avatar look/state.wear → critter-model.js humanBody + humanMorph and wardrobe-split.yml; each visible Ward_ outfit piece becomes a tinted, morphed skinned child, while seatWardrobe removes stale children and updates existing ones.

scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings and roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume; hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js and mall counters write shop/food state for handlers and UI.
Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/lib/hub.js, which boards the player via bc-train and crosses to the destination.

Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickups, including cells, enter player.js inventory.

Kick action → scripts/kick.js handles foes/loose objects and wheeled furniture; first-person kick spawns articulated thigh/shin geometry from scripts/kick-leg-geo.js and delayed kickSnap camera feedback; scripts/grab.js carries/throws eligible bodies and props.

Player and M.E.G. combat handlers → scripts/lib/body3.js stance/swing/fire/aim/reload → combat-anims.yml; scripts/lib/stats.js and ballistics.js apply weapon skill/handling, with energy weapons consuming cells.

Level 0 main sim → maze.js seeded geometry/cell helpers and level0-moments.js; scripts/moments.js handles placed moments (including peelable wallpaper); smilers.js/lurkers.js use maze0path and sneak.crouchMul, while lurkers cap chase speed.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js + scripts/salon-stylist.js/scripts/salon-ui.js - authored mall shops/landmarks and simulated mall life; salon chairs queue sitters and expose styling UI.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds attach screen, sound, and glow.

places/level01/sim.js + scripts/zenith-geo.js + scripts/zenith-breach-geo.js + scripts/zenith-door.js + scripts/zenith-bots.js + scripts/zenith-hatch.js + scripts/zenith-flicker.js + scripts/zenith-drones.js + scripts/zenith-use.js - Zenith Station geometry, breach, doors, robots, hazards and mission props share a versioned layout and quest state.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/hair/model/wardrobe data + art/human-cloth/{wardrobe.py,split_wardrobe.py,check-bust.py,compile_wardrobe.py,wardrobe-check.mjs} + art/human-head/* + art/human-hair/build.py - deterministic avatar looks; furry clothing is body material/parts, while human wear uses bare bodies with only the look's standalone skinned garment children.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js + scripts/meg-agent.js - shared human combat/gait, idles, head tracking, fidgets, expressions, and dialogue; player/enemy combat uses common body animation routines.

scripts/lib/sneak.js + scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml - common crouch sight multiplier for smilers and lurkers, varied by crouch movement, darkness, and flashlight; player detection independently accumulates awareness for HUD feedback.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace; level01 is named in hub/feed data and is not a solo home.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.

Level 0 place.state.momentsV is now 7: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them. lurkerGrabGrace in level0.yml is seconds (8), stored as player.state.lurkFree in ctx.now() milliseconds and checked by every lurker grab.

Level 12 ritual tuning is in scripts/lib/data/level12.yml: sit/hour/tol are seconds (45/180/12 currently); r12.back is a ctx.now() millisecond timestamp and the exit requires the return-door attempt within tol seconds of one hour. The log/window knowledge is player state.

scripts/lib/data/sneak.yml tunes crouch visibility and awareness rates: crouch still/moving, dark and flashlight multipliers combine in crouchMul; preserve skill-based hunter sight and the crouch-only awareness/HUD state path.

Footstep surface detection checks visible geometry within 0.45 m before collider; terrain chunk hits use terrain.materialAt. Keep material words/tags and mapping priority in scripts/lib/data/footsteps.yml. Human split wardrobe sw31 uses bare bodies plus per-garment skinned children; keep SPLIT garment keys aligned with WARDROBE.parts and bump STYLE_V when changing bodies/outfit assets so existing occupants are restyled.
